What the record says

  • The Bengals' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is favored by 3.5 to 6.5 (since 2002): 37-27 against the spread, a 57.8% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is road favorite (all time): 63-72-4, 46.7%.
  • On totals since 2002, the over hits most often when the closing number is under 38 (26-11, 70.3% over) and least often at 48 or higher (29-44-1, 39.7%).
  • All time they have covered 53.6% at home and 48.7% on the road, a 4.9 point edge at home.
